inlines.v: SEG'MENT, noun. [Latin segmentum, from seco, to cut off.] 1. In geometry, that part of the circle contained between a chord and an arch of that circle, or so much of the circle as is cut off by the chord. 2. In general, a part cut off or divided; as the segments of a calyx.
